name: Calle de Jorge 39–67 passage, from the south-pool lawn into Pintor Dalí
trust: The Dalí mouth is the placed arch in door_sills.json (IMG_2283/2294/2295). The passage runs inward along that arch's axis and leaves the east face of 6263501UF1366S_part1 at 20.4 m, where IMG_2645 looks at the iron gate. Clear width 2.1 m carries the built approach. Three bays of equal length: covered, open court (IMG_2640), covered. Flat ceilings, not a vault. Arch spring, crown and the 20.4 m depth are estimates, good to about 2 m; the indoor cameras are not solved. The 67 39 CALLE DE JORGE plaque is on the right wall of the lawn portal (IMG_2641).
